ping.title: Check the API key
ping.description: Verify that the API key is accepted. The cheapest call there is, and the one to run before blaming an endpoint for a 401.

get_feed_url.title: Get a feed URL
get_feed_url.description: Build the url of the standalone Beamer feed, optionally identified as one user and filtered to a segment -- the link to send someone who should see their own personalised changelog.

language.description: Language code for the feed, e.g. "EN".

filter.description: Segment filter to apply to the feed's posts.

force_filter.description: Segment filter applied even to posts without a filter of their own.

filter_by_url.description: Restrict to posts targeted at the current page url.

user_id.description: Your own id for the viewer, so the feed is personalised.

theme.description: Theme to render the feed with.

list_posts.title: List changelog posts
list_posts.description: Read the changelog posts. `published`, `archived` and `expired` narrow to the state you care about, `category` and `filter` to a kind or segment. Note that `saveViews` counts a view against each post returned, so leave it off for reporting.

published.description: Only published posts, or only unpublished ones.

expired.description: Only posts past their due date.

category.description: Only posts in this category, e.g. "new", "improvement", "fix".

language.description: Return the given language's version of each post.

filter.description: Only posts targeted at this segment filter.

force_filter.description: Segment filter applied even to posts with no filter of their own.

filter_url.description: Only posts targeted at this page url.

date_from.description: Only posts dated on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only posts dated on or before this date.

user_id.description: Your own id for a user, to scope the results to what they would see.

filter_by_user_id.description: Apply the segment of the user named by `user_id`.

save_views.description: Count a view against each returned post. Leave off for reporting.

ignore_filters.description: Ignore segment filters entirely and return everything.

count_posts.title: Count changelog posts
count_posts.description: Count posts matching the same filters as list_posts, without pulling the posts themselves -- the cheap way to answer "how many unpublished posts are there".

filter.description: Only posts targeted at this segment filter.

filter_url.description: Only posts targeted at this page url.

date_from.description: Only posts on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only posts on or before this date.

get_post.title: Get a changelog post
get_post.description: Read one post by id, in the language you ask for.

user_id.description: Your own id for a viewer, so the post is read in their context.

traceable_links.description: Rewrite the post's links for click tracking.

create_post.title: Create a changelog post
create_post.description: Write a changelog post. `title` and `content` are **arrays**, one entry per language, paired positionally with `language`. `publish: false` keeps it as a draft; publishing makes it visible in every embedded feed at once, and `send_push_notification` additionally pings existing users. `filter` targets a segment; `filter_url` targets particular pages.

title.description: The post's title, one entry per language, aligned with `language`.

content.description: The post's body (HTML allowed), one entry per language, aligned with `language`.

language.description: Language codes for the entries in `title` and `content`, e.g. ["EN"].

publish.description: Publish immediately. False keeps it as a draft.

pinned.description: Pin the post to the top of the feed.

show_in_widget.description: Show the post in the embedded widget.

show_in_standalone.description: Show the post on the standalone changelog page.

link_url.description: Call-to-action url, one entry per language when several are used.

links_in_new_window.description: Open the post's links in a new tab.

date.description: The date shown on the post.

due_date.description: When the post should expire out of the feed.

filter.description: Segment filter deciding who sees the post.

filter_user_id.description: Show the post only to this user id -- a single-user announcement.

filter_url.description: Show the post only on pages matching this url.

enable_feedback.description: Let readers leave feedback on the post.

enable_reactions.description: Let readers react to the post.

enable_social_share.description: Show social share buttons on the post.

auto_open.description: Open the feed automatically for users who have not seen this post.

send_push_notification.description: Push a notification to existing users about this post.

user_email.description: Email address to attribute the post to as its author.

update_post.title: Update a changelog post
update_post.description: Replace a post's fields. Same array-per-language shape as create_post, and setting `publish` to true on a draft releases it -- readers see the change immediately.

title.description: New title, one entry per language.

content.description: New body, one entry per language.

publish.description: True releases a draft; false unpublishes.

send_push_notification.description: Push a notification about the update.

delete_post.title: Delete a changelog post
delete_post.description: Delete a post along with its comments and reactions. Archiving it with update_post is the reversible alternative.

output.description: Confirmation that the post was deleted.

list_unread_posts.title: List a user's unread posts
list_unread_posts.description: Read the posts one user has not seen -- what the widget would show them on their next visit. `mark_as_read` clears the badge as a side effect, so leave it off unless that is what you want.

user_id.description: Your own id for the user. Use this or `user_email`.

user_email.description: The user's email address. Use this or `user_id`.

filter_url.description: Only posts targeted at this page url.

date_from.description: Only posts dated on or after this date.

mark_as_read.description: Mark the returned posts as read, clearing the user's badge.

save_views.description: Count a view against each returned post.

count_unread_posts.title: Count a user's unread posts
count_unread_posts.description: Count what one user has not read -- the number behind the widget's badge -- without fetching the posts or marking anything read.

user_id.description: Your own id for the user.

filter_url.description: Only posts targeted at this page url.

date_from.description: Only posts on or after this date.

output.description: The unread count for that user.

list_post_comments.title: List a post's comments
list_post_comments.description: Read the comments readers have left on one changelog post.

date_from.description: Only comments on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only comments on or before this date.

search.description: Search text matched against the comments.

create_post_comment.title: Comment on a post
create_post_comment.description: Add a comment to a changelog post on a user's behalf. It appears publicly in the feed under that person's name.

user_id.description: Your own id for the commenter.

delete_post_comment.title: Delete a post comment
delete_post_comment.description: Remove a comment from a changelog post. It disappears from the public feed.

output.description: Confirmation that the comment was deleted.

list_post_reactions.title: List a post's reactions
list_post_reactions.description: Read the reactions on a post and who left them, optionally narrowed to one reaction type.

date_from.description: Only reactions on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only reactions on or before this date.

create_post_reaction.title: React to a post
create_post_reaction.description: Record a reaction on a changelog post on a user's behalf.

user_id.description: Your own id for the reacting user.

list_feature_requests.title: List feature requests
list_feature_requests.description: Read the feature-request board. `status` follows your roadmap columns and `visible` separates what users can see from what is internal; `search` matches title and body.

status.description: Only requests in this status, e.g. "planned" or "shipped".

visible.description: Only requests visible to users, or only internal ones.

filters.description: Segment filters the request is targeted at.

search.description: Search text matched against title and content.

date_from.description: Only requests on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only requests on or before this date.

count_feature_requests.title: Count feature requests
count_feature_requests.description: Count feature requests matching the same filters as list_feature_requests, without pulling them.

visible.description: Only user-visible or only internal requests.

date_from.description: Only requests on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only requests on or before this date.

get_feature_request.title: Get a feature request
get_feature_request.description: Read one feature request -- its title, body, status, vote count and category.

feature_request_id.description: The feature request's id, from list_feature_requests.

create_feature_request.title: Create a feature request
create_feature_request.description: Add an entry to the feature-request board, optionally on a user's behalf. Like posts, `title` and `content` are arrays paired with `language`. `visible: false` keeps it off the public board.

title.description: The request's title, one entry per language.

content.description: The request's body, one entry per language.

visible.description: Whether users can see the request on the board.

status.description: Roadmap status to start it in.

notes.description: Internal notes, not shown to users.

filters.description: Segment filters the request is targeted at.

votes_count.description: Starting vote count, for a request imported from elsewhere.

date.description: Date to record on the request.

user_id.description: Your own id for the requesting user.

internal_user_email.description: Email of the team member filing this on a user's behalf.

update_feature_request.title: Update a feature request
update_feature_request.description: Change a feature request -- most often its `status`, which is how it moves across the public roadmap, or `visible` to publish or hide it.

title.description: New title, one entry per language.

content.description: New body, one entry per language.

visible.description: Show or hide the request on the public board.

delete_feature_request.title: Delete a feature request
delete_feature_request.description: Delete a feature request with its votes and comments. Hiding it with `visible: false` is the reversible alternative.

output.description: Confirmation that the request was deleted.

list_feature_request_comments.title: List a feature request's comments
list_feature_request_comments.description: Read the discussion on one feature request, including internal comments.

visible.description: Only user-visible comments, or only internal ones.

search.description: Search text matched against the comments.

date_from.description: Only comments on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only comments on or before this date.

create_feature_request_comment.title: Comment on a feature request
create_feature_request_comment.description: Add a comment to a feature request. `visible` decides whether users see it or it stays an internal note.

visible.description: Whether users can see the comment.

user_id.description: Your own id for the commenter.

delete_feature_request_comment.title: Delete a feature request comment
delete_feature_request_comment.description: Remove a comment from a feature request; it disappears from the board.

output.description: Confirmation that the comment was deleted.

list_feature_request_votes.title: List a feature request's votes
list_feature_request_votes.description: Read who voted for a feature request -- the list behind the vote count, and the people to tell when it ships.

date_from.description: Only votes on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only votes on or before this date.

create_feature_request_vote.title: Vote for a feature request
create_feature_request_vote.description: Record a vote for a feature request on a user's behalf.

user_id.description: Your own id for the voting user.

delete_feature_request_vote.title: Remove a vote from a feature request
delete_feature_request_vote.description: Withdraw one vote from a feature request, lowering its count.

output.description: Confirmation that the vote was removed.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: Read the users Beamer has seen, by your own `user_id`, Beamer's `beamer_id` or email address. These are the people segment filters apply to.

user_id.description: Find the user with this id of your own.

beamer_id.description: Find the user with this Beamer-assigned id.

user_email.description: Find the user with this email address.

create_user.title: Create a user
create_user.description: Register a user with Beamer, which is what lets posts be targeted at them and unread counts be tracked. `filter` is the segment string that decides which filtered posts they will see.

user_id.description: Your own id for the user.

filter.description: Segment filter string, deciding which targeted posts they see.

update_user.title: Update a user
update_user.description: Change a user's details or segment. The user is picked by the query identifiers -- `user_id`, `beamer_id` or `user_email` -- and the body carries the new values.

user_id.description: Identify the user by your own id.

beamer_id.description: Identify the user by their Beamer id.

user_email.description: Identify the user by email address.

delete_user.title: Delete a user
delete_user.description: Delete a user identified by your id, their Beamer id or their email address, along with their read state and votes. Irreversible.

user_id.description: Identify the user by your own id.

beamer_id.description: Identify the user by their Beamer id.

user_email.description: Identify the user by email address.

output.description: Confirmation that the user was deleted.

list_nps_responses.title: List NPS responses
list_nps_responses.description: Read the NPS survey answers with their scores and comments. `score_from` and `score_to` isolate promoters or detractors.

search.description: Search text matched against the free-text comments.

date_from.description: Only responses on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only responses on or before this date.

count_nps_responses.title: Count NPS responses
count_nps_responses.description: Count NPS responses in a score band and date range -- the counts behind an NPS calculation, without pulling every answer.

search.description: Search text matched against the comments.

date_from.description: Only responses on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only responses on or before this date.

check_nps_eligibility.title: Check whether a user should see the NPS survey
check_nps_eligibility.description: Ask whether one user is due the NPS prompt, according to your survey frequency settings. The check to make before rendering it yourself.

user_id.description: Your own id for the user.

output.description: Whether the user should be shown the survey.
